RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Both you and the successful candidate are women; nothing you’ve described indicates that sex influenced the decision, although that cannot rule bias out.

Your PhD and eight years of leadership are substantial qualifications, but a higher degree does not automatically outweigh other relevant experience or interview performance.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment, and the reasons the successful candidate was preferred. Check any applicable review or appeal deadlines rather than waiting indefinitely. Raise panel composition only if a specific rule required different representation or additional evidence suggests bias.
